source.source: Direct user message in current root conversation, 2026-10-21; quoted by /root, not an API export
source.quote: 森林的tile set得和风铃平原的整体风格一致，只是体现不同的区域特色。你这个都直接扔掉了
source.scope: Both direct user corrections apply to all later region creation, optimization and proposed Bibles. Preserve the active project style; regional identity varies within that family. Not acceptance of future visual output/devices.
source.additional_quote: 同时后续区域不要出类似的问题

shared_dimensions.pixel_scale: 继承正式平原actual terrain_build的16px source tile /32 world units和nearest采样；通用Blob47Rules.SOURCE_SIZE不冒称当前素材像素尺寸。
shared_dimensions.adjacency_and_boundary: 继承同一47-mask邻接语义、核心TileMap与非整格exact-boundary adapter，保留solid/one-way/moving和危险语义；不为图改变碰撞，也不把精确边界冒称全网格。
shared_dimensions.lighting_outline_material: 以当前source PNG/atlas和shader为同族参考，继承像素簇/亮边宽度、暗实体/断面/凹角阴影、光向、材质分面及克制纹理。所有后续区域均不得独立换项目画风。只有用户明确选定新global style后，才通过版本化补充、影响分析和重验替代共享母版。 同屏角色以正式平原实际UnderworldPlayer表现为共用参考，保持角色与地形尺度/材质协调。
shared_dimensions.regional_variation: 森林差异来自树皮、苔藓、荆棘、有机根枝结构与区域色域；制作与正式平原同族的新材料/边界矩阵，不把平原岩石换色冒称森林。

historical_boundary: 旧提案或失败实现不自动约束新区域；这不等于抛弃正式平原仍在实际使用的Underworld tileset家族。保留原许可/来源、正式消费者和已有效的公共接口。
validation: Supplement or any shared reference SHA drift blocks new calls and resumes; versioned impact analysis/rebind and fresh affected technical/visual evidence required. Original Bible bytes and old receipts remain unchanged. Cross-region actual golden comparison is required before expanding new regional materials; metadata and hashes never sign visual acceptance.
region_scope: Every current catalog region and later new region; the two original Bible documents are unchanged.
